title: lysionotus angustifolius

This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
